Società Sportiva Cosmos is a Sammarinese football club, based in Serravalle and founded in 1979. Cosmos currently plays in Girone A of Campionato Sammarinese di Calcio. The team's colors are green and yellow.\nThe club is named after the New York Cosmos team.
